title: Provider not registered
description: abs apply --force where the Microsoft.BotService resource provider is not registered on the subscription. The read-only preflight fails, so apply refuses with a typed provider-not-registered error (exit 1, environmental) and performs no mutation.

json.errorMessage: Cannot apply: The Microsoft.BotService resource provider is not registered on the subscription. Register it before applying.
json.remediation: Register the Microsoft.BotService resource provider on the subscription (`az provider register --namespace Microsoft.BotService`, or via the portal), then retry.

stderr: Cannot apply: The Microsoft.BotService resource provider is not registered on the subscription. Register it before applying.
Register the Microsoft.BotService resource provider on the subscription (`az provider register --namespace Microsoft.BotService`, or via the portal), then retry.
